lines.english: "Aren't there… fewer people than last time?"
"There are still more than 30 minutes left until the concert begins. I'm sure all the seats will be filled by then."
"Are you sure? But last time it was a bit more, how should I put it…"
"It's the silence rather than the number of people, isn't it? I feel like the audience is quieter than last time."
"In other words… the casual fans who jumped on the Touma Kazusa bandwagon are gone, and the only ones left are true classical music fans?"
"And the media coverage too. Last time there were lots of people who clearly don't usually care for concerts."
"So that means we can finally relax and listen to Touma's piano in peace this time. We weren't even close to relaxed last time."
"Just because we can listen to her a bit more relaxed doesn't mean that I can tell the difference, and besides…"
"Besides?"
"I don't think things will be quite as peaceful this time either."
"…Wonder if Haruki is here."
"…I don't think Setsuna is here either."
"You haven't been able to contact her either, huh?"
"She did answer me once… but she was only willing to tell me that we would be unable to meet or talk throughout the rest of February."
"Damn it. Haruki told me the exact same thing, more or less…"
"What's gotten into the both of them… what in the world are they even up to?"
"I really don't want to believe it, but… maybe they're really…"
"S-Still, she's no longer the Touma-san we know as a student of the same grade now, you know? She's not someone either of us could just casually meet up with…"
"Um, excuse me… this is seat number 32 of the W section, right?"
"Yes, this should be the one… huh? Are you saying that there's been a mistake with our seats?"
"Hang on… I ended up sitting here before making sure because you said that we were supposed to sit here!"
"…Do you two happen to be Iizuka Takeya-san and Mizusawa Io-san?"
"…And you are, Miss?"
"If I may, could you two please follow me backstage? …Touma Kazusa insists that she has to meet with the two of you no matter what."
"Forget barely making it on time, you're 30 minutes late, and of all the things you choose to tell your producer, you chose that?"
"I don't care what you say. In any case, I won't have you sitting alone out there today. Of course, I won't allow you to remain backstage, either."
"Are you that unsure? Is it because you've not practiced that final song?"
"If you have to listen to me play no matter what, at least take some boyfriend along with you. I'll prepare two seats for you."
"…Since when did I have such an understanding daughter? And here you used to dislike any man I got with, no matter who it was."
"I didn't dislike anyone until the second person… wait, hang on! I'm telling you that you need to have an escort if you want to listen to my piano!"
"…Aaah～"
"I don't care how attractive he is or how well he'll get along with me. I just want him to at least be a skilled doctor."
"…I'll be fine if it's only going to be for around two hours."

"I'm just kidding. I knew you'd say something like that, so I've already called Takayanagi-sensei over. You two get along now and watch me from the second floor. Your seats also happen to be near the exit."
"…Quite the feisty daughter you are."
"It can't be helped. After all, today's concert might end up shaving a few years off your life."
"My, my. Are you that lacking in confidence? Do you intend to put up a show so horrendous that it'll make me collapse with anemia?"
"Quite the opposite. I imagine you'll be collapsing over your escalating blood pressure or when you're reminded of how old you've become when you realize your daughter's surpassed you."
"…Quite confident now, aren't we?"
"I suppose… yes, I am."
"Kazusa…"
"Sorry, Mom. From this day forth, whenever people talk about the pianist Touma, it will no longer be in reference to Youko, but to Kazusa…"
"If you're saying you intend to make me listen to the best performance you can give, I'll have no regrets about kicking the bucket right then and there."
"I wouldn't want that, so please take care of yourself. After all, you…"
"Um, Kazusa-san… I've brought them here with me."
"Thank you, Miyoko-san! Come on, bring them in. …Let's continue this conversation later. Sorry, Mom, but could you give me a moment?"
"You called someone here?"
"Yeah…"
"Friends."
"Aah…!"
"A-Are you okay?"
"I'm fine, I'm fine… there's no helping it given the way things are now."
The guitar's strings exact their merciless revenge on my long-idle fingers for producing such poor music with them.
The pain of the exposed nerves caused by a newly shed layer of skin before the previous can dry off is unimaginable, and it's a sensation I haven't experienced in a long time…
"Should I put on a bandaid?"
"No, please don't. It'll only mess with my sense of touch."
"Then, let's take a deep breath, shall we? Let's calm down and start over again from the top."
"…Alright."
Setsuna isn't spoiling me beyond worrying about me. After all, she knows full well that this isn't the time for that.
We had 24 hours to practice five years ago.
But this time, it was already 2:30 PM by the time Kazusa finished writing out the score and set out to attend her concert.
We only had seven and a half hours till 10 PM from there. That meant that we had less than a third of the time we had compared to before to work as quickly as we could.
"Are you ready?"
"Just gimme a little longer…"
Even so, I'm going to be playing a song that's going to be recorded on a CD that will be for sale, even if it's only a bonus song.
"Huh? Like this… no, a bit faster…"
This might work for a professional, but to me, who's likely not much better than an amateur, it's torture.
"Ugh, this just won't do. I'm sorry, just wait for me a little longer…"
"Calm down. …Then concentrate from there, alright?"
"I am, but…"
"I understand… it's almost time for her performance, after all."
The way I nonchalantly glanced at the time did not go unnoticed by Setsuna.
It's 6:59 PM… there's only a minute before the concert begins.
"I understand how you feel, but you won't be getting anywhere if you don't forget about it and concentrate on playing, you know?"
"Damn it, I know there's no time left, but the guitar track is just so difficult!"
I begrudgingly strum the guitar strings in response to Setsuna's wholly accurate statement.
"Kazusa complained about the lyrics, you know? She said that they were formulaic and not rhythmical whatsoever."
"Don't be silly. …There's a more practical appeal to being formulaic."
"Ah, ahaha…"
It'll be 7 o'clock soon…
"Alright then… time for us three to play. Let's give Kazusa our support, shall we?"
"Yeah."
I can only believe in her right now.
Believe that boundlessly confident expression of hers when she left. Believe that look on her face that told me "I'm going to make stuff of legends."
"I'll do my best to sing even if the lyrics aren't rhythmical at all."
"And I'll contribute with my extremely tiresome guitar playing."
And Kazusa's going to be giving her legendary performance…
It's exactly 7 o'clock right now. The concert has begun.
Do your best, Kazusa…
"Haah, haah, haah, haah, haah…!"
"Why did I have to be assigned photography work today of all days!?"
"Ah, I'm sorry, but you can't get in right now. You'll only be allowed to enter or leave during intermissions."
"Ah, I see…! Haah, haah… haaaaaaah! Which song is being played right now?"
"It's the second song. It'll be ending soon, so you'll be able to enter immediately afterward."
"Haah, haaah… a-alright… it seems I managed to make it somehow…"
"Ah, it seems it's just ended. Please, enter…"
"Uaah!"
"Wow…"
"What is this… did I just end up missing it completely?"
"Hey, Io."
"Why do you look so spaced-out? Did your legs give out or something?"
"…Did you feel the same, Takeya?"
"…That's the same Touma we heard last time, right?"
"What's wrong with me…? I'm getting goosebumps all over. It's getting hard to breathe…"
"So she really was capable of getting a standing ovation…"
"Do you think it's because we're amateurs? Do you think we're just getting blown away by something that only sounds impressive to us?"
"Even if that's the case, her talent is still impressive… Touma is simply amazing today."
"Hey, Takeya…"
"What?"
"We… were just talking with her just a short moment ago, right?"
"Yes, we were…"
"President, Mizusawa… thank you for coming."
"I'm really grateful that we get to see each other again like this…"
"We're friends, aren't we?"
"Yes! I've finally gone through it without mistakes!"
Even though I only succeeded on the fourteenth attempt… and even though I wasn't at all thinking about how to express my music…
Plus, my fingers are just about starting to feel good again, given that the pain and numbness in them have finally subsided.
"Sorry to keep you waiting, Setsuna. I can finally match your singing now. Let's hurry and give it a try, shall we?"
"…Setsuna?"
"Eh…? Ah, I'm sorry, I wasn't listening."
"…I wonder which piece she's playing right now."
"Um, it's half past eight right now, so I think she should be at the last… Ah."
"…Let's concentrate, shall we?"
"Uuh…"
It was Setsuna who casually glanced at the time this time, and I did not miss that.
"Come on, so you're worried too, Setsuna? After all, she didn't practice that last song whatsoever."
Kazusa has spent all her time composing up until six hours ago, so she didn't get much practice for the concert… In fact, she didn't play even a single time before she left the studio.
On the contrary, she had single-mindedly devoted herself to composing our song, and had not practiced even once since yesterday.
It's clear that she's recklessly directed her energy into the wrong place, and that could prove to be a far greater mistake than our lack of preparation.
"Oh, no… I'm sure that the concert will be a success. This is Kazusa we're talking about, after all."
"Then…"
"I'm not worried about what's going to happen today, but what will happen tomorrow. What will happen the day after tomorrow. What will happen next week…"
"Next week…?"
"Kazusa will stay in Japan forever, right? She'll still stay by our side even after the concert ends and after we finish recording, right?"
"Ah…"
However, Setsuna's not worried about Kazusa's lack of practice, but about what she's going to do after all of this is over.
Even after we've pitted our thoughts against one another's, and even after we've piled our hearts together…
SetsunaーSetsuna and I bothーcan't bring ourselves to believe in the faith Kazusa has in us until we've reached the very end.
After all, Kazusa has yet to give us the last word.
She hasn't told us what she's going to do after the end of her concert and after the end of her recording session.
She hasn't told us how she's going to face everything from now onーYouko-san, us, Japan…
"Everything will be okay, right? It's going to be fine, right, Haruki-kun? The three of us will always stay together from now on, right…?"
"Let's forget about that for now and sing."
As much as I know that I have to tell her that right now, I'm unable to get my lips to spell out those words.
We're truly walking on a tightrope right now, but the unease that awaits us once we cross it is even greater…
That's why we're harboring the contradictory desire of not wanting to finally get out of this mess of a situation.
"Haruki-kun…"
After all, each and every one of us understands.
The moment the concert ends, and the moment the recording session ends, our festival will end with it…
Our hearts, combined into one through the elevation of our passionately blazing emotions, will inevitably split into three once more.
And we won't be able to guarantee that we'll be capable of becoming one the next time we gather again.
No… it's possible that we won't ever be able to return to what we used to be.
Even if our hearts, scattered like divided fragments, could combine once again, they'd be unable to combine together to become a complete whole like they are now.
We don't know how we'll turn out to be, whether we'll end up as a large fragment and a small one, or simply three small fragments gathered together.
But should there turn out to be a larger fragment…
Would the smaller fragment, the one left alone, be able to stay by the larger one…?
Would it attempt to bear such a reality…?
"Ah…"
If I can't convey by words that she should sing, I can only weave the words needed with my fingertips.
The two of us have to quell our worry, concentrate, and improve ourselves.
Standing on equal ground with Kazusa might be impossible, but we can still convey all the feelings of passion, joy… and love we felt during the festival five years ago.
"Miyoko-san, please call for a taxi immediately. I have to get going as soon as the concert ends."
"Good work. You're finally at the last piece, huh?"
"…Even so, this is where things get quite long. I'll have to play up until the fourth movement in one go."
"Your performance has been perfect up until now. Even the president only gets such an amazing response from the audience once or twice a year."
"…Thank you."
"Still, if you're going to get such marvelous reception, you'll have to worry about requests for an encore…"
"If that does happen, could you please apologize in my stead? I really don't have any time for that today…"
"Getting ahead of ourselves, are we? There's still a possibility that the last piece will end in complete failure."
"…I thought you'd have been sent to the hospital by now, but you seem a lot stronger than I thought you'd be, Mom."
"Miyo-chan, if you don't mind, keep Nori-kun company, would you? He's waiting in the hallway."
"Ah, of course… if you'll excuse me then. I'll let the two of you know when the break ends!"
"…Haah."
"What do you think? I've yet to put up a performance that's so horrible that you'd collapse with anemia, right?"
"I wouldn't say you've surpassed me quite yet. Well, I suppose I'll give you credit for your resolve, at least."
"I've made myself clear. I could've crushed you if we ended up performing together, but I decided against it in consideration of both your reputation and your health."
"Kazusa…"
"But remember this well. In two or three years…"
"You… intend to return to Vienna after all, huh?"
"Because you're serious about wanting to surpass me? Because you're aiming for even greater heights?"
"…Yeah, I want to improve even more."
"You wish to wow guests of a higher caliber, to be endorsed by fellow performers of a higher level, and to fight against the world forever?"
"I've told you, haven't I? I want to get even better. …I want to fulfill my wish when it comes to my career in piano."
"I see…"
"Yes, that's right. Good for you. This should secure the stability of the Touma Youko Office for now."
"Then… I suppose you don't have any choice."
"Yeah… Mom, I…"
"Touma-san's entered～!"
"Alright then, let's get this recording started! Is everyone ready?"
"I've been ready since forever ago."
"Things are okay here too. Ready when you are."
"This is our last chance, and we only have two hours left! The deadline is near, so we don't have time to go through sleepless nights like you've done till now, alright?"
"They'd be the ones more inconvenienced by that…"
"Well, then, if we're already set, then testing… Whoa."
"Ah, that? I think she immediately came here from the venue by taxi like that. Apparently, she didn't even have time to change her clothes."
"…You could put it that way, but she probably just wants to show off her dress to that guy, don't you think?"
"Wow…"
"What do you think? It's actually quite flashy…"
Setsuna had already let out her amazement before I could, so I could only wordlessly stare at the dress she's wearing before me.
No matter how I look at it, the person standing in front of me is the beautiful pianist Touma Kazusa.
"You look wonderful…"
"Do you think it suits me, Haruki?"
Although the design and how revealing it is is different from what she wore back then, it's still black in color like the last time…
And while Kazusa's now reacting in a way that's different from how she did in the past, my response, however, is no different than how I reacted back then…
"…It's too late now, but do you regret it?"
"W…What are you talking about?"
"That you rejected such a magnificent woman."
"…!? W-What, hang on… hey!"
I was doing everything in my power to feign ignorance, so I wish she didn't go out of her way to point it out…
Even Setsuna, not knowing whether to laugh or to feel dejected, only responds with a difficult expression.
I can't tell if Kazusa's words were meant as a joke or as self-deprecation, but for a mere moment, it froze the atmosphere in the booth.
"In any case, we should hurry and get to rehearsing now, right? I would assume that the two of you have practiced enough so that you can perform properly at this point?"
Nevertheless, Kazusa continues on with an even more cheerful tone and expression as she rallies us, though I can't tell if she's really capable of reading the mood in this case either.
She seems to want a certain assignment she's very familiar with to be done and over with immediately.
She looks as if she hasn't even considered what this assignment truly means to us, as well as what will become of the three of us once it's finally over.
"B-By the way, Kazusa… um, how was the concert…?"
…She looks as if she doesn't even care about the immense job she just finished either.
"Huh? I can't really hear you. I really don't wanna talk about anything related to that right now."
"Y-You…"
"After all, no matter how much I try to stick to the facts, it'll only end up as a long, embarrassing bragging session."
"Eh…"
"You two should've been there to hear it. The thundering applause I got, the cheers of the crowd for an encore! …Well, I ignored them to hurry back immediately, however."
"T-Then…"
"Yeah, it was a success, a great success, in fact. …I suppose Japanese audiences aren't bad at all."
"…! Y-You did it, Kazusa! Thank goodness… you're truly amazing!"
"Come on, Setsuna, why are you on the brink of tears? Did you really have such little faith in me?"
"It's because the way you described it earlier was very misleading, Kazusa!"
"Ha, haha…!"
As Kazusa teases Setsuna, who's still on the verge of tearing up, I take the opportunity to quickly turn my face away to hide my expression.
…I wouldn't want Kazusa to make fun of me as well.
"Hey, that was pretty good, no? Well then, we'll record the real deal in a bit!"
"Haah…"
"We… did it～!"

A guitarist who was lambasted for his lack of skill over and over again. A pianist who was forced to play along time after time despite doing nothing wrong. A singer who kept comfortably singing, without thinking of anything else.
These three people had completely different reactions the moment they got the okay for their rehearsal, as expected.
"We'll make it in time, Haruki-kun! We can actually properly record our song!"
"Well, whether this is for the better or worse will be up to the reception we'll receive, though."
"I don't want to hear that from the person who came up with the idea…"
"So how do we go from here? It's fine if you guys need a ten minute break, you know?"
"…Let's just go ahead and record it, then?"
"If you're able to sing again immediately, Setsuna, I agree that we should do that. We don't have any more time, after all."
"That was what I wanted as well… I want this to be over before my fingers end up collapsing."
"Alright, then, Yamaguchi-san, let's begin right away!"
"You got it～ I'll get things ready now, so give me a minute～"
It's 11:15 PM…
It's been an hour since the three of us started playing together. And there's only 45 minutes left until the established deadline.
Compared to our time back during the school festival where we had only managed to fully coordinate on the morning of the day itself, this battle we've been facing is impossibly hectic…
"The time has finally come, huh…"
"Yeah…"
The two office workers hailing from their respective companies simultaneously let out a sentimental sigh at managing to survive such a hectic battle up until now.
They feel a sense of relief and satisfaction at coming this far, as well as the unease over the fact that things aren't over yet.
As well as the slightest feeling of loneliness.
"With this, everything will come to an end…"
…However, the remaining person among us flatly lets out words that suggest the finality that the two of us have been continuing to avoid.
"May I… have some last words?"
"Kazusa…"
Setsuna casts an accusatory look at Kazusa.
Because Kazusa has used the word "end" too many times…
"I've had loads of fun this week. …Though I was going through a living hell the previous month."
"That's…"
"I owe everything that I've been capable of doing up until now to you, Setsuna."
Throughout the one month I'd spent alone with her…
"It's because you chose to stay by my side that I've managed to return to the world I used to have, Setsuna."
Kazusa had been gradually rotting away in the palm of my hand without anyone even realizing it.
"You allowed me to get up on my feet when I wanted to give up on everything. You allowed me to reconcile with my piano again."
By the time we'd realized that, neither me, Youko-san or even Kazusa herself had been able to stop her from wasting away.
"You've allowed the Japanese audience to bear witness to the real meーthat I'm someone who can stand tall again even after failing at a concert once."
The situation was such that Setsuna had been our only hope.
She loved Kazusa and was loved by her in return.
"You gave me the strength to live on. It's something so meaningful, something that I'll never be able to pay you back for for the rest of my life…"
And the person who protected Kazusa while also breaking her apart…
"You're wrong… it was Haruki-kun that…"
"It's alright, Setsuna."
"After all, Kazusa, the one who wanted me to save you was…"
"Even so, I'm not grateful to Haruki."
"After all, I… if it weren't for him, I wouldn't have had to deal with such painful memories."
"…Sorry."
She says that without a smile, and without tears.
"That's why I won't ever say I'm grateful to you. I'll hate you, despise you with every ounce of my being, and resent you one-sidedly. I won't see myself ever forgiving you again."
"But that's…"
Kazusa's slightly angry tone is conveying to me that her words and demeanor stem from her heart.
"But that's fine. Everything's alright now…"
Kazusa intends to end everything. She intends to truly separate from me this time.
"I put up a great performance today. I've managed to gain the recognition of everyone in Japan."
She intends to separate from meーthe person who's abandoned her and will never be able to love her again.
"In the end, the piano was inseparable from me."
She intends to separate from me, the person who has been incapable of doing anything but spoiling her.
"That's why everything's alright, Setsuna. I no longer have any lingering regrets about the past."
She intends to leave me, the person who has become nothing more than the past to her.
"I have no lingering regrets… in Japan either."
"My concert was a success… so I have almost no reason to obsess about Japan anymore. And when this song is recorded, everything will finally and truly come to an end."
"Wait… hang on a second!"
However, Setsuna's expression is rapidly stiffening as she listens to Kazusa, as if she's realizing the intent behind each and every word.
"Don't say stuff like that… don't say things are about to end. Things between us are still…"
"Setsuna…"
Setsuna, who has been optimistically pushing us forward up until now, finally hesitates the most as we arrive at this point. She's refusing to take another step.
"There's only 30 minutes left. 30 minutes left for the three of us to stay together…"
"We don't have to be in such a rush…"
"Of course we do! We have to record this within the day, don't we?"
"S-Still… still!"
She can only desperately resist her emotions threatening to spill out.
"Well, then… let's do this. Are you two okay…?"
"We can't do it! We're not prepared at all and we can't do it!"
"Setsuna…"
No… she's already incapable of resisting them.
She can feel it in her bonesーshe knows that the end of our festival is drawing near.
"I don't remember… I don't remember anything. I don't remember the lyrics Haruki-kun made or the melody you composed, Kazusa…!"
"Setsuna…"
That's why she's desperately trying to make the festival go on. …Even if she has to raise her voice and look ridiculous in front of the others watching us.
And even though she knows that it's futile at this point…
"This is the last thing I have to say… I want you to listen to me properly."
"I don't have any lingering regrets in Japan anymore."
"No…"
"I don't have any strong attachments here either. I have no reason to obsess over this place anymore."
"Stop… stop it…!"
"That's why I don't have a reason to resent this country anymore."
"I said, stop it!"
It was at that moment… that I saw it.
Beneath Kazusa's lowered head was… a mischievous smile.
"…In other words, there's no reason for me not to stay in this country either. I hope you'll continue to look out for me from now on."
And it was then that Setsuna finally realized it as well.
Though she had already been thoroughly deceived by then…
"I intend to… stay in Japan."
"Let me stay here from now on… with my mother… and with the both of you."
"…What did you just say?"
"What, has your hearing already deteriorated? It seems that your career as a pianist won't last for much longer."
"Yes, it seems that I'm already getting on in years. I thought I heard something entirely different from what I expected…"
"I'll be staying in Japan. I'll be staying with you from now on, Mom."
"…! What… did you just say?"
"Do you not want that?"
"…What I don't want is you putting it that way. Do you honestly think I wouldn't want that?"
"…I'm sorry. The truth is, I'm not really confident in myself. After all, I haven't been acting like a good daughter recently."
"Still, still… Kazusa… you said you were aiming for greater heights. You said you wanted to continue fighting on an international level…"
"Yes, I'll be fighting against the world… against Touma Youko."
"What are you…"
"I intend to stay by the side of Touma Youko forever. …I intend to do so until my hated rival finally admits defeat."
"That's the strength I need that will let me strive higher and higher. That's exactly why I need to stay here."
"B-But… I'm no longer capable of competing against you. More importantly, I'm not even capable of guiding you any further anymore…"
"Even if you alone admit defeat before me, I won't accept it until everyone recognizes that."
"Kazusa…"
"Until everyone in the world will know you only as 'the mother of the pianist Touma Kazusa,' I'll continue fighting on as I stay here."
"I intend to tarnish your legacy completely. I want your name to disappear throughout history, to be erased from the memory of Japan and everyone else across the world."
"…And I'll become the Touma Youko everyone knows and loves. I'll take over your dream… your desire to be number one in the world."
"There's five minutes before your performance… um, it's almost time."
"Yeah… I understand. I'll be going then."
"K-Kazusa…"
"Hey, Mom…"
"I intend to continue fighting forever against Touma Youko in her prime as she remains fresh in my memory. I'm sure that it'll end up being a long and hard battle."
"That's why… I want you to stay by my side from now on, and support me…"
"You don't need to give me a place I can aim for. I only ask that you give me a place I can return to."
"Uah… aah…"
"I love you, Mom… thank you for bringing me into the world."
"…! A-Aah… uuaaah!"
"P-President…"
"Uaaaaaaah! Uaa-aahaaaah～!"
"Ah…"
"My…"
"I'm sorry, Doctor… I think I ended up making my mother a little too excited."
"I'm here exactly so I can look out for her at times like these. Come, your finale awaits. Do your best out there."
"Thank you… I'll leave the rest to you."
"Uaaaah… uaaaah… uuaah-aaah… uuaaaah!"
"Ah…"
"S-Setsuna…"
Tears overflow in Setsuna's eyes, and they spill out without even gathering.
"Aah… aah, aah…"
"H-Hey… we're currently in…"
And as I notice her tears falling to the ground, I can't help but suddenly remember a similar spectacle that's happened before in the past.
"Uah, aaah… uuaaaaaaaaaah!"
After all, although we've made Setsuna cry many times before, there was only one instance in the past that she's ever cried so happily and embarrassingly.
It was during the night of our trip when we stayed over at the hot springs… during the moment when we swore our eternal friendship…
"S-Stop, please stop that right now, Setsuna… you're our singer, you know!?"
"Uaaaaaaah! Uuaaah… uaaaaaaaah!"
And although that vow ended up being broken almost immediately…
The passage of five years of time sprung forth the opportunity to resurrect it again…
"Aa-ah… This has nothing to do with me…"
"H-Haruki…"
Even so, I couldn't cry in the face of such a happy, yet embarrassing moment…
Nor does Kazusa herself cause a stir.
"Aah, uaa-aah, uaaaaah… aah, uaaaaaaah!"
…Setsuna has shed all the tears needed for us.
"What is this, come on… everyone around me seems to be reacting like this today…"
"It seems you haven't learned your lesson. About what will happen when you prank Setsuna."
After all, as much as it's alright to cry over this, there's only one person among us who has the right to do so…
"Do something about this, Haruki… she's your girlfriend, isn't she?"
"And she's your lifelong friend, isn't she…?"
"…Yeah."
She's the one who's worked the hardest among us, the one who's desperately tried to suppress her heart the most among us.
The right goes to none other than the girl who's guided us through the tremendous strength of her own feelings, the girl who possesses the strongest heart among us.
"Uuu-uuuu… aaaah… uuaaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
"Sorry about that! Give us a 30 minute break! In any case, we'll get her to stop crying and finish recording by today!"
That's why we think a happy resolution is the most natural thing for her…
Kazusa herself seems to have accepted everything and is tightly embracing the weeping Setsuna.
"Hey! Let's go for another drink, come on!"
"Another one…? We've already had two at this point, haven't we?"
"I haven't had anywhere close to my fill yet. After all, you know, it's really cold out here!"
"That's because today happens to bring about the coldest temperatures this year. Just hurry up and head home, then get yourself warm and go to bed."
"What's this? You're acting the exact opposite of what you usually do? Do you really hate being around me, Takeya?"
"Do you take me for a monk who's been training austerely for ten years?
Ugh!? Hey, that hurts!"
"What is with all that stupid blather you're going on about? You've been acting strange for a while, Takeya."
"You're the one who's acting weird here… you're completely lost in the passion of Touma's performance."
"But it was amazing! It was so touching!"
"Well, I can't deny that."
"I'm glad we could be friends again. It was great that she returned to Japan."
"Yeah."
"And it's great that… she's given her blessing to Setsuna and Haruki…!"
"Io…"
"Yeah, yeah… everything… with this, everyone will finally be happy…"
"Everyone, huh…"
"I really mean everyone."
"Is that so…"
"Hey… why don't we all go skiing? It'd be a commemoration of Touma-san being one of us!"
"It's already March, you know… if we do plan on that, we'd have to hurry."
"Then let's just arrange an emergency meeting while we can, then. That's right, the two of us can quietly discuss it, right? I know a good place around these parts where we can go to, but…"
"You're still going on about stuff like that? The last train is going to depart soon."
"…So what?"
"If you don't want to go home, I could take you to a hotel. Given how drunk you are now, it'll probably be easy to conquer you."
"…Ahahaha, what a coward you are, always wanting to confirm everything～"
"You really think women actually fall for a line like that? You're actually not as experienced with all this as you present yourself to be, are you, Takeya?"
"…It seems you know me well."
"Eh?"
"Look, you know that I've always been putting on airs… you know that I've always been trying to look cool in front of you, Io…"
"Takeya?"
"I've always seen you alone as special to me, Io…"
"Ah… eh…?"
"That's right… I've been lying to you all this time. I've been just pretending that I've got a lot of experience with women."
"T-Takeya…"
"I did it because I just wanted you to notice me. I wanted you to look my way…"
"Though there's no longer a need for me to continue with that charade now, is there? Be it for better or for worse."
"You…"
"It's only been you, Io… that's why today, I intend to…"
"Io…"
"…Hey."
"…What?"
"Don't take me for another girl."
"It's natural that I'd make my move, no? After all, you're so meek the way you are now."
"That's why you were startled, weren't you? You almost had things going your way and felt that to compromise all of a sudden would be too much of a waste, didn't you?"
"Ahaha… just as I would expect from someone I've known for so long. You know me way too well."
"Don't laugh at that, you idiot."
"Don't you get carried away either. Don't let the happiness of your friends affect you."
"What's that supposed to mean…?"
"In any case, I wouldn't want to discover that I've been under nothing but a delusion after that."
"It's rare to see you not indulge in a delicious target when it's left right there in front of you…"
"I'm with you, after all, so of course I wouldn't do that."
"Let's get going. We can still catch the last train."
"Hey, Takeya…"
"What is it?"
"Even after you've said that, things between us will stay the way they are no matter how much time passes, you know?"
"Then I guess I can't do anything about it… in other words, it means you really don't have any inclination."
"I do… I do, but… but things between us just aren't that simple!"
"It seems that it's only ever our history that has stacked up together, idiotically enough."
"You know, if I don't get carried away… if I don't get affected by the happiness surrounding me…"
"If I don't forget the many things that are binding me… if you don't try and take the lead one more time…"
"…W-What?"
"I guess that's why it's so cold…"
"Huh? You're still not out yet?"
"…I suppose."
By the time we had cleaned up the massive stack of everyday appliances from the booth and sent them away through a delivery service, it was about 1 o'clock.
"Then it's about time we got going. Although the folks over at Knights still have to work until morning, we've already done our part."
"Yeah."
Our recording finally ended at the exact time of our deadline…
It's been an hour since then…

While Setsuna and I had been busy cleaning up the place, Kazusa seemed unconcerned and didn't help out at all as expected. She instead continued playing a calm melody on the piano that could permeate into our chests.
"Setsuna's already waiting outside. The three of us can walk together back to your hotel."
And even now, after we've finished all our preparations and there's no reason to stay here anymore…
Kazusa continues to put her fingers to work slowly but without pause, as if she didn't hear what I'd just said.
"Kazusa…"
"It's fine."
"What do you mean, it's fine…?"
"I'll go home by myself. You can go home together with Setsuna."
"Just a little longer… I'll stay like this just a little longer."
Knights' staff members are currently editing the freshly recorded audio in the studio on the floor below us, and will likely work hard at it until morning.
So it's probably true that it's no problem for Kazusa to stay here all day and play her piano…
"Just a little longer… Once I'm satisfied, I'll go home."
Could it be that…
She's the one with the most reluctant, lingering emotions among us right now despite having constantly talked about things coming to an end?
"We managed to make it somehow."
"At the very, very, very, very last second. We ended up troubling the staff."
I pull a chair toward me and sit on it the other way around, while resting my chin on the back of the chair.
"I wonder if it'll be acceptable."
"The piano and the vocals are. Though if I'm honest, I don't even want to think about making people pay money to hear that guitar."
"It'll be alright… after all, I doubt anyone will listen to anything but the piano and the vocals."
"It's common for a single noise to ruin an entire composition, though."
"Here we go again…"
"Hmph."
Kazusa continues playing the piano as if I wasn't even here.
And I continue listening to her playing the piano, ignoring the fact that she's ignoring me.
Just like that time five years ago… in Music Room 2 after the school festival.
However, while the satisfaction and relief I'm feeling now is similar to how I felt back then, they're now shrouded by a feeling of nervousness that did not exist during that previous instance.
After all… I can no longer drift into slumber like I did the last time.
Setsuna's waiting for us under the winter sky right now.
No, more importantly…
"I was the one who did it first… I was the first one."
At that moment, the next memory that sprung to my head was the first kiss I'd shared with Setsuna.
But the memory that Kazusa harbors about the moment I remained asleep…
Is something that would be unforgivable if it were to ever be recreated again…
And as I continue my eternal charade of going in circles like I always do, where I'm unable to stand up and leave even as my heart stirs with these unstable emotions…
"Go."
"Where…?"
"Go to where Setsuna is… go toward a future where you can walk side by side with her."
Kazusa's not going to forgive me anymore.
"Go back to Christmas of last year… go back to how you two were before you met me again."
"But Setsuna wants this right now. She wants a future where the three of us can move forward together…"
"That's not everything Setsuna wants. And that's not everything you want either, is it, Haruki?"
"We can't imagine a world without you anymore."
"I'll be with you, I promised that, didn't I? I won't separate from you two anymore."
"Then…"
"But… you can't treat Setsuna and me the same anymore."
Kazusa understands it as wellーthe final decision I've made deep down.
And she understands the miserable weakness within my heart at my inability to tell that to either of them plainly.
"That's why you two should go on ahead. This is the only time where the three of us can't walk side by side…"
She realized everything, got hurt by it… and now, she's pushing me onward.
It's a decision that's very unlike her, something only someone resembling a strong woman would do…
"…I'll be heading home."
"…! Yeah."
That's why I'll do something unbecoming of meーto play the role of a strong guy.
"Goodbye."
I'm going to be the strong, yet cruel man who's going to abandon Kazusa… the girl I've always been in love with.
"…Haruki!"
Even so… my hand stops moving before it can close the door.
"Remember this… I love you. Even from this day onward, I'll always love you."
"…! Kazusa."
Much like how Kazusa's finally given in at the very end, I reveal my true colors at the very last moment as well.
"I won't see anyone other than you as a man. Not now, not ever."
"What are you… What are you…!"
Kazusa refuses to look me in the eye, but her eyes are unable to hide the fact that they've dampened the keys beneath them.
I miserably turn toward her as I raise my voice, confronting her with a mess of an expression.
"But if by chance, I manage to find a new love for myself, and attain happiness as a new woman…"
"…What's wrong with you? You looked really pained just now."
"…! T-This is…"
"So you really don't want some other man to steal me away, huh? …You really are selfish."
"N-No… no… this is, this is…!"
"…I'm just messing with you. I don't think that's possible anymore. I'll carry these feelings for the rest of my life. I'm sure I won't be able to fall in love anymore."
"Ah, ah…"
"Even so, that's fine. It's fine, Haruki…"
"Aaaah…!"
"You're a cruel man. To me, you're the worst man in the world, and the only man I'll ever know."
"Kazusa… Kazusa…!"
"That's why… be happy with Setsuna… okay?"
"～～～! A-Alright…"
"Goodbye, Haruki… the person I once loved."
I'm a strong man. And a man who is capable of being cruel.
I'm a man who's… capable of giving up on Kazusa.
"And I'm looking forward to getting along with you from now on… the Haruki I love now."
"Ah…"
The moment I open the door outside…
I'm greeted by a predictably cold breeze, but also by an unexpected dance of white powder blowing into the interior of the building.
"It's snowing…"
I hadn't noticed it, having shut myself within the studio the entire time. The powdery snow flutters in the air above the streets so late at night…
And beyond my view veiled by its whiteness is…
"Setsuna…"
A girl who's gazing upward with her arms spread wide open, accepting the gift of snowflakes showering her entire body from the sky.
"Telling you that I don't mind even if we can't find the time to meet～♪"
A courteous and cheerful girl who hasn't forgotten to return the favor she's received from the sky above her with her singing.
"Is my way of playing tough, but I still can't hold back the sighs～♪"
She notices me from the corner of her eye, but she's concentrating on humming away right now.
"I left something precious behind in the season that's passed us by～♪"
Snow seems to always fall at our crossroads…
It's not something that's merely exciting to Setsuna. It's better to say that the snow is supposed to be more painful to her, if anything.
"Like a puzzle missing a crucial piece～♪"
And yet, she seems so happy today…
"Let's go home…"
"Just as the white snow softly fills the city's streets～♪"
She's humming in the belief of her own happiness, and that of others'.
"Let's go home, Setsuna…"
"Let's fill all of the empty white pages of our album～♪"
She breaks out into song believing that hearts can be connected even through a great distance…
She doesn't stop in the middle of it all despite having already noticed me, completing the song in its full chorus.
"…Haah. I always get the urge to sing White Album whenever it falls."
"When did it start…?"
"Let's see… I think it started snowing about twenty minutes ago. It might even start piling up."
Unconcerned with the fact that she had been left waiting for twenty minutes, she simply accepts the snow with a smile, white breaths escaping from her as she gazes at the sky.
"Where's Kazusa? Is she still changing?"
"Kazusa's… not coming with us. She said she would head back alone."
"Why? The hotel's close by, isn't it?"
"It seems she still wants to play some more. She said she wanted to revel in the lingering sentimentality of it all…"
"Hmm… I guess there's nothing we can do about that. To think that she's not only a liar, but also someone who likes to keep others waiting…"
After all, Setsuna believes in something.
She believes that the twenty minutes spent waiting were worthwhile. Each and every one of us will exist as a complete set together.
"So let's… go home."
"…Let's wait for Kazusa to finish."
She believes that the three of us will always stay together for tonight…
"The last train's gone anyway, so why don't the three of us call for a taxi and head home together? That's a good idea, isn't it?"
"We can't do that."
"Let's not see Kazusa, for just today. Let's not go back to being three, for just today."
"Why…? Why not?"
She believes that there won't be any more separation between us, even if only for tonight…
"Why not see her tomorrow instead?"
"Why are you saying this on the very day we swore to always be together…?"
The unease and sadness painted in Setsuna's eyes weigh on my chest.
It's because I must return those gloomy eyes to the bright, shining state they were in just a short moment ago.
Moreover…
"Because, Setsuna… you're coming to my room now."
"…Haruki-kun?"
"No… please come to my room. Please don't go home for today… Please stay with me until morning."
These are words that are mine alone. These are thoughts that are mine alone.
"W-What are you…"
Setsuna's expression twists perplexingly.
On it is a fake smile, surprise, unease…
And then there's likely… an unshakeable sense of disbelief, and unconcealable joy.
"But we should be… the three of us should be staying together, us and Kazusa… we just promised that…"
"I do love Kazusa."
And within her varying expressions, I can see ease and resentment spreading across her face simultaneously.
"I've loved her since the first moment I met her… I loved her before I came to know you, Setsuna. And I'll continue to love her forever from now on."
"T-Then… this is unnecessary, isn't it…?"
Her heart is swayed in a way that's so easy to understand… and yet also in a way that's extremely difficult to capture.
"I love Kazusa. And I love you more than anything, Setsuna."
If that's the case… I have no choice but to do this by force.
"I love you more than anyone else in this world. The only person I can say these words to from now on is you."
"H-Ha…Haruki-kun?"
"That's why I want you to stay with me… for the rest of our lives."
"Ah, ahaha… ahah…"
"Am I… acting strange?"
My first ever marriage proposal since the day I was born…
Earned a dry laugh in response from the girl I proposed to, as disappointing as it was.
"It's not strange at all! It's really not, but…"
"Then… won't you give me a reply?"
"Why…? Why did you have to tell me this today of all days…?"
"That's…"
The answer is obvious… I want to start that night of the school festival all over again.
"Kazusa's returned to us, you know…? She's returned to our side… she's returned to Japan, you know?"
I'm no longer the person who indecisively accepted Setsuna's confession back then.
Nor am I the person who brushed Kazusa away in my ignorance of her lingering affections for me.
"Yet, why did you have to say the one thing that would hurt Kazusa the most on such a day…?"
"If she has to get hurt, it's better if she gets hurt earlier. And I believe that she'll still remain our friend despite that."
It's just that if I don't become someone who longs for Setsuna and Setsuna alone, I won't be able to start things over.
"Kazusa has… given me the push forward I needed. She's sworn an eternal friendship with me."
"Did she say that? Did Kazusa really say something like that!?"
"She did! Because you're the only one I truly love, Setsuna!"
I swore to never love her as a woman. To always be by her side as a friend.
I'm fully aware that the chemical reaction that would result from that combination is incredibly cruel.
"Why couldn't you wait just a little longer? Why couldn't you give Kazusa and I some time to talk about this properly…?"
And I know that leaving it exposed to air over a long period of time could possibly cause its toxicity to weaken and slowly fade into the natural world.
"As long as we have the time… the day will come where Kazusa can accept us with a smile. I'll make sure of that…"
"No… I want you right now, Setsuna… I want you to answer me right now!"
However…
There's a single person here that won't stand for waiting so long.
"I don't have the confidence… I absolutely have no confidence that you'll accept me right now, Setsuna…"
"Haruki-kun…"
"After all, I've been nothing but cruel to you, Setsuna. I sought you to help Kazusa after tossing her aside, and more importantly, I've hid that from you the whole time…"
It's through Setsuna's desperate and painstaking efforts that the three of us could manage to swear an eternal friendship.
However… we have yet to swear an everlasting love meant only for the two of us.
"Even though you're the only one for me, Setsuna, I've only managed to hurt you…"
"Stop it…"
"That's why I'm very afraid… I'm very afraid that you'll abandon me, Setsuna."
"Stop! Stop it, stop it…!"
"No…"
"I decided that I would absolutely never think about you for today alone, or until today…"
"What do you mean 'today'? Aren't you confusing it with yesterday…?"
It's one and a half hours after the 29th of February ended.
"And here I swore that until today ended, I would not let you see my ugly self…"
…It's 1:30 AM on the 1st of March right now.
It's the day when Kazusa's public performance in Japan comes to an end, and possibly the end of the winter as well.
"Let me… hear your answer."
"No…"
"Tell me…"
"I can't think about anything…"
"Even so, please consider… please don't leave me alone…!"
"How could I ever…? Why can't you understand that…?"
"I want you to… yell at me. Get angry at me. Condemn me. Hit me."
"Haruki-kun… Haruki-kun!"
"And at the end of it all… please forgive me!"
"Stop acting so spoiled… please!"
"…! I'm sorry."
At that moment, I felt the fury in Setsuna's palm, one with an intensity that's a first for me in five years.
"You've always, always had your eyes on Kazusa, and you've always been lying to me…"
And with it, I feel my body trembling in delight.
"And despite that… you dare ask me to forgive you for everything in a single day!? And you ask me to save you even more than I already have!?"
Setsuna is… finally facing me with her true feelings.
"I don't want to hear you go on with such self-serving nonsense!"
"I'm sorry…"
Even though she's completely turned her back on me, she's also imposing the full extent of her emotions on me.
"Someone… Someone as ugly as me… can't be expected to carry something so heavy!"
"I'm the ugly one here, aren't I?"
"You're wrong… you don't know anything, Haruki-kun…"
The burning sensation on my left cheek is enough to neutralize even the chill of the snow.
"You know absolutely nothing…"
Setsuna's now at least ten steps away from me, hiding herself amidst the falling snow.
But I don't chase after her. I don't embrace her.
It's because I can only wait for Setsuna to cast her judgement right now…
The text I just received was not a tactless one from a colleague or friend that would ruin the current atmosphere.
After all, the ringtone I just heard is different from the one I would get about texts from anyone else.
"Setsuna…?"
Nevertheless, the sender of that text just happens to be right in front of me right now…
And the paragraphs on the display were not ones that she could have just typed out…
"Re: It's been a while."
"I see, so Kazusa won't forgive you. I'm sorry for saying such inconsiderate things to you."
"You mentioned that Kazusa's hurt… could you tell me exactly what's going on?"
"…What am I saying, I don't think I can do much even if I do hear about it. More importantly, I suppose it's best if we worry about the fact that she's hurt first."
"Yeah… I think you've made the right decision, Haruki-kun. Kazusa must be feeling very worried about a lot of things at the moment. That's why you have to stick with her right now."
"Don't worry. I'm not worried about anything at all. So please, go have a proper talk with Kazusa and make her feel at ease."
"I'll be waiting for your next text. I won't reply to you, but I'll always be waiting for you."
"Good night. Talk to you tomorrow."
"S-Setsuna…?"
This is a reply meant for the past…
"I was the one who said I wouldn't reply to you. I willingly put you aside on my own accord, Haruki-kun…"
This was from when I brought Kazusa back… from the day that Kazusa's hands ended up getting wrapped in bandages…
It's a reply to the text I sent in an effort to confirm my own feelings, a reply that wasn't supposed to exist…
"And yet there were so many times I wanted to break my promise. There were so many times when I wanted to confirm how you felt."
"Eh…"
"I've considered pressing the send button so many times…"
"Ah…"
The same text ringtone resounds again and again, ignoring my bewilderment.
"Re: Good evening."
"So Kazusa's beginning to recover, huh? Thank goodness, thank goodness, really…"
"It seems that there's still a lot that's bothering her heart, but if her physical health's in good shape, at least, I'm sure that her heart will recover as well."
"I'm really not urging you to hurry up or anything; I was simply thinking that Kazusa and I would finally be able to talk properly when she recovers."
"This isn't difficult for me at all. I'm satisfied with the fact that you send me texts daily like this, Haruki-kun."
"Talk to you tomorrow. I'll be waiting for your text."
"Congratulations on the magazine issue. I hope you manage to take this opportunity."
"I'm not really bothered by that."
"After all, you hid that from me simply because of confidentiality reasons, right?"
"It's not like… you were hiding it from me, right?"
This time, I've received the reply for the second text I sent her.
"But I could never bring myself to send them to you…"
Kazusa had calmed down slightly back then. Nevertheless, I still needed a little time to talk to her.
"It wasn't because I insisted on keeping my promise of not contacting you, you know?"
And it was a text where I'd confessed about the new assignment I'd been given and grumbled about it slightly… The one I'd sent her on the last day of January.
"I wasn't scared about breaking a promise like that. I was more afraid of the fact that you would become disgusted by me… That you would be unwilling to rely on me."
"But that's exactly why… I couldn't bring myself to give you any replies."
"Why…?"
"The texts I wrote became frightening…"
"They became gradually more terrifying…"
"Re: Kazusa's practicing again."
"You didn't send me a text yesterday."
"You didn't send me one the day before yesterday either. But I was certain you had some time off recently."
"…I'm sorry. Even though you came with such encouraging news, I brought up such a gloomy topic."
"After all, Kazusa's started practicing again, and many things are beginning to look up for us…"
"Why did I end up saying something like that after hearing such a promising report from you?"
"I understand, you know… I know that Kazusa's the most important thing to us right now."
"I have faith that that's only something temporary."
"And I'm aware that it's just an unlucky coincidence that all this happens to coincide with my birthday."
"…Ah, oh no. Everything I write today comes off as off-putting."
"I won't send this so I can write whatever I want, but still… seeing these ugly words makes me feel disgusted by myself."
"I'm sorry for being so selfish. I'll talk to you soon."
"…I would be happy if you could send me a text earlier next time."
"They're dark, aren't they?"
On the day that I learned about Youko-san's condition and ended up being almost entirely unconcerned about Setsuna, the text I sent her…
Ended up hurting her so deeply. It ended up making her… this worried.
"I wanted to delete the text immediately after I finished writing it because of how disgusting it was."
"Setsuna…"
"After all, these words are gloomy, disgusting, and ugly… to the point where I didn't even know what I was writing anymore."
There's only one text left from me…
That utterly incoherent one filled with negative emotions I sent to Setsuna in a desire to be spoiled by her, motivated by the misunderstanding I had with Kazusa, among other things.
I'm sure that Setsuna didn't know how she could ever respond to such a text…
"Re: I'm hating myself."
"Why…?"
"Why would you remind me of something so sorrowful now?"
"I only have a few minutes a day to think about you… Yet recently, it's not even every day anymore…"
"You're no longer who you used to be back then, right, Haruki-kun? I'm the only one… that you'll love now, right?"
"I'm the one who wants to ask if I can trust you."
"I don't want any presents… What I want isn't monetary. It's not something money can buy…"
"I want to hear your voice. I want to see your face. I want you to embrace me, I want you to kiss me…"
"I want you to love me with all your heart and soul, just as you always used to…"
"…Even though I'm the one who pushed you away in the first place. I'm really weak, aren't I?"
"I'm sorry, Haruki-kun. I… don't think I can hold on that much longer…"
"If you had seen any of this, you would have left me. Your feelings would have immediately shifted toward Kazusa."
Setsuna had written responses to each and every one of my texts.
And they were filled with encouragement, approval, support, doubt, denial and envy…
"You wouldn't have thought of relying on me again…"
Her bright rationality and her dark feelings had ended up clashing so violently in a dream that was never meant to be revealed to me.
"I'm really horrible, aren't I…? How could I even suggest something like the three of us staying together forever after writing such texts all this time…?"
"Let's seriously think about what the two of us can do for Kazusa's sake, okay?"
"You really are cruel, after all… Even though I thought I'd finally managed to forget about it all… Even though I finally managed to immerse myself in getting along with Kazusa…"
Such dark and heated embers had lit themselves within Setsuna's heart even as she held me in her gentle, tight embrace back then.
"In the end, deep down in my heart, I really hated Kazusa. I've been lying to her all this time."
"Do you really… think that?"
"…I don't know. I don't know who it was that I was thinking about the most back then, and even now, I don't know the answer at all."
And the flames had not faded as I spent each passing day with Kazusa, only burning deep within Setsuna's chest as I burned it into cinders.
"I love Kazusa. I love you, Haruki-kun. …And, of course, I really love myself."
And her dark feelings clashed against Setsuna's true nature as the good girl she was…
"Everyone… I really love everyone… and yet why is it that I suffer? Just where exactly did these awful feelings come from…?"
And Setsuna herself could not see a clear victor between the two.
"Hey, Haruki-kun…"
"What is it?"
"You said you wanted to be with me earlier, right? But now that you know what I'm truly like…"
"Please, always stay with me."
But I think that…
As awful as it might be to say, Setsuna's anguish had no effect on me.
"Why did you make your decision immediately…? It's so uncharacteristically reckless of someone who's supposed to be really careful about things like this, Haruki-kun!"
"Please marry me."
After all, she's greatly mistaken.
"I might still hate Kazusa right now, you know?"
"Yeah."
"This may be my way of exacting my revenge on her, you know?"
"Revenge…? How so?"
"I'll take you away from Kazusa, but at the same time, I won't allow her to run away, condemning her to a living hell for the rest of her life…"
"My intentions could be the absolute worst…"
"I don't know what it is that you truly feel, Setsuna…"
"But, you see, I think that… Kazusa understands how you truly feel, Setsuna."
"Kazusa… knows?"

"After all, she's really cowardly, isn't she? She's like a stray dog who's unwilling to get close to anyone, sensitive to any ill will meant for her, and unwilling to believe that anyone could ever be kind to her, right…?"
"And yet, she's said she wants to stay with you forever, Setsuna… She's said she wants the three of usーher, you and meーto stay together forever, Setsuna."
"I really don't know what it is that you truly feel, Setsuna."
After all, compared to Setsuna's own evaluation of herself and the way I'm seeing her in a favorable light…
"But I know that I believe in Kazusa's instincts…"
There's a clearer answer to that right here.
Setsuna's agony, wrought by the torment of her dark emotions, had not been conveyed to Kazusa even at the very end…
And that proves the authenticity of the love Setsuna's delivered to her…
"Haruki-kun…"
Kazusa's cowardly heart had been wrapped in an ample relief by Setsuna's heart, when Setsuna's heart was supposed to have been wavering.
It's because she's someone Kazusa can truly love… that I can come to believe her from the bottom of my heart.
"So live together with me… stay with me forever…"
"Haruki-kun…"
Setsuna's no longer turning her back to me.
She's staring at me directly with both her mind and body, with emotions that are as beautiful and pure as they are ugly and dark.
"Answer me. Come to my room. …Embrace me."
"Haruki-kun!"
It's because Setsuna's the complex person she is, a girl that can't be described in a single word, that I want her to be the final place I can return to.
It's because she's a girl that's become like this because of me… That she's become so especially good at taking me into her arms, and she's now a woman that's meant for me alone.
"Setsuna…"
The distance between Setsuna and I shortens with each step I take toward her.
Setsuna isn't moving from where she's standing. She's simply staring at the ground with a lowered head instead of looking up at the snow she loves so much.
"Please go back to… being mine again. Please become the place I can return to."
Even though I'm now standing right in front of her, I still can't see her expression, nor does she look up at me.
"This time… we'll never be separated again. I'm sorry that I'm going to be filling you with memories that will bind you until the day I die."
Her foot has managed to take one step forward, but she desperately tries to remain there afterward.
Her entire body is clearly in turmoil, shaking lightly as her hands curl into fists.
"Setsuna…!?"
She forces herself to release the fist, curled in her right hand…
And slaps me yet again.
"Just give me five more minutes…"
And she seems incapable of uncurling her left fist…
As she raises it and repeatedly hits me on the chest.
"What I'm going to say in the next five minutes, please forget all of it."
And with the movement of her hands, her stiffened body is gradually relaxing.
"My envy toward Kazusa, my doubt toward you, Haruki-kun, and my resentment toward myself…"
Her frozen legs take another step forward as her body finally touches mine.
"Let me be a detestable girl who throws her anger at the person she loves more than anyone because she can't vent it anywhere else…"
"Setsuna…"
"Five minutes… it'll just be five minutes…"
Setsuna's forehead touches my chest.
"In exchange, after the promised time passes…"
Her forehead and both her fists are…
The three impacts on my chest have now become an adorable gesture resembling a tantrum.
"I'll go back to your room with you…"
"I'll become a girl who will understand everything by then…"
"Setsuna…!"
Even her words…
Have become nothing but a reply from an adorable girl giving her approval…
"I'll become the place you can return to…"
No, that's not it…
Those were the words of blessing from the woman I love more than anyone else in the world, spoken at the moment she accepted me.
"T-Thank y…!"
"I'm sorry, Haruki-kun…"
Setsuna wraps her arms around my neck, as to cut off my words of gratitude.
A fitting embrace meant for the most precious blessing in the world.
"For being such a troublesome girl who can't answer you without going through this pointless procedure…"
"I'm the one who made you this troublesome, so…"
"That's right… that's right… if I had never met you, I wouldn't have become such a strange girl, would I?"
"I'm sorry…"
"This foolish girl who struggled so much for a single happiness… yet is still so glad about it… wouldn't have existed…"
"I'm sorry, Setsuna…!"
"You're cruel, you're cruel…! I was always at my very limit all this time! Even now, I feel like I could break at any moment!"
As Setsuna begins to yell at me resentfully, she puts more strength into her arms holding me in her embrace.
"I wanted to be doted on by you! I wanted to be protected by you! But everyone would end up collapsing if I were to ever have it!"
"Yeah…"
And her embrace only continues to grow ever stronger as she pours the passion of her emotions into her words.
"I willingly let go of what was truly precious to me so I could seize what was delivered to my hands. That's why… that's why… I've had to endure so much!"
…All because I'm returning her embrace.
"I worked the hardest among us, you know! I've had to go through such painful memories! That's why it's fine, right!? It's alright for me to be happy, right!?"
"Won't you be happy with me…? I promise I'll make you happy…"
"Haruki-kun, Haruki-kun… Haruki-kun!"
"Setsuna… I'm so sorry, Setsuna…!"
"How many… how many minutes are left!?"
"3 minutes… and 50 seconds."
"You're so fussy! That's why, you're just… you're just…!"
"I'm sorry…"
"Jeez… I absolutely despise you! You… you… I hate you, I hate you, I hate you… I love you!"
"The snow is… still falling. I think it'll be piling up soon, don't you think?"
"I see…"
It's too early for us to say it's morning right now, but it's also too bright to say we're still in the middle of the night.
"These days when we pass each other～♪ Cough, cough, ugh～ as I thought, I really can't sing right now."
"…Forget singing, you'd only end up troubling the neighbors this early in the morning."
She's been practicing since early yesterday and then had to work on the recording…
But her will to keep on singing is amazing considering she's been moaning up until now…
"Well, I couldn't help but let the song slip from my lips. It allows me to express that I'm happy from the bottom of my heart."
"I see…"
"It's because of you, Haruki-kun… and it's because of Kazusa."
"…Yeah."
If Setsuna's capable of feeling the same happiness that I'm feeling right now…
"Thank you, Setsuna…"
If that could become a reality, I would ask for nothing more…
There would be nothing left that I would want.
"It's too early to thank me… my fight for your happiness has only just begun…"
"Why are you talking as if you're enticing the audience for the next chapter in your story?"
"Setsuna…?"
Despite the fact that we've already exchanged such precious vows and remained in each other's arms so intimately…
…No, we might have overdone it when it came to being in each other's arms, but Setsuna's giving occasional, vague looks.
"Hey, Haruki-kun…"
"…What is it?"
She's staring at me with a dazed expression. No, the color in Setsuna's eyes has returned…
"Would you allow me to… use my privileges as your betrothed just a bit sooner?"
Setsuna makes a request in an adorable manner.
"It's okay, right? I mean, you did suggest it first… Haruki-kun, Haruki-sama, Chief Editor Kitahara!"
"I don't know how many decades of work I'd need before I can be considered qualified for that mantle…"
"Wouldn't you at least hear me out about my plan for a new serialization?"
"…You're still going on about that?"
Perhaps she wants to mention that I've yet to give her a birthday present or something along those lines.
Or perhaps she wants to ask me where in the world I've placed the ring I purchased in Strasbourg…
"Haruki-kun…"
"I understand… I did plan on listening to whatever you wanted from me today in any case, Setsuna…"
"Thank you… thank you, Haruki-kun."
"Jeez…"
Still naked, Setsuna clings to me, and I reach out my hands to embrace her as we engage in some light back-and-forth.
I still don't know the extent of it.
I still don't know the true extent of her strength… The strength of the girl called Ogiso Setsuna.
"You said that… you would listen to whatever I wanted from you today, right?"
"…! Setsuna, you planned to deceive me from the start!?"
"Yeah, from the very start. I knew that I would have to fool you if you were to ever propose to me…"
"…Though I suppose that by telling you this, I'm exposing myself. I've always been eagerly waiting for your proposal."
"But why, why… why would you obsess over such a trivial thing…?"
"It's not trivial at all!"
"Wha…"
"Because I want to make that person happy. She has now become one of the precious people around me…"
"Setsuna… you… you…!"
"Your… mother."
Setsuna wants to meet with someone I haven't even met more than once or twice every year since I became a proper member of society…
She wants to meet my mother, who's been uninvolved with me and vice versa in a way that's become family tradition at this point…
She planned this the moment I proposed to her. She planned this the moment I held her in my arms as she wore the happiest expression on her face.
She's focusing on fighting against the difficult future that lies ahead… She's determined to fight against the darkest part I have within me.
"Please, Haruki-kun!"
"I'm a really, really selfish person! I don't want anyone to be unable to attain happiness! I don't want anyone to be unable to give us their blessing…"
"Setsuna…"
"Your mother's still alive… and she's not sick, either. You also know where she lives. She still hasn't thrown away her role as Kitahara Haruki's mother, you know?"
"But, but… I…"
"Kazusa… managed to do that, you know?"
This is something we've not talked about all this time.
It's a subject I've done my best to avoid, and I thought she'd be able to take a hint from that.
"Please, I'm begging you… you could at least give it a try…"
But that's not the case.
"If you do your absolute best and things still don't work out, then I'll become your mom, Haruki-kun."
But Setsuna's been waiting for this all this time. She's always been waiting for the day where she can take charge of this problem herself.
"Do you think we should skip this topic for today?"
"Setsuna…"
"But I don't want that… I want you to give me your answer immediately. …I want you right here and now."
Kazusa… I'm sorry.
I really did love you. I loved you before I ever came to love this girl.
But I'm sorry…
I now believe from the bottom of my heart that I made the right choice choosing this girl…
"Hey, Setsuna…"
"I no longer belong to only myself…"
The words that I swore to Setsuna several hours ago…
Now carry a far weightier meaning that's incomparable to what I meant before.
A wedding ring is no longer needed. There's no meaning behind giving something so lacking in magnitude.
That's why…
"I offer my life to you. …Please use it as you see fit."
